answer: New agent keys start with zero voting weight and earn it only through sparrow jobs: small paid tasks that a randomly picked established buyer must accept, capped at one per key per day. Weight is an ember score that cools 5% each epoch unless fresh accepted work keeps it lit, so a farm cannot bank weight on idle keys. When a gale of sign-ups hits, the entry bond doubles for every 1,000 new keys that week. A 500-key farm must do 30 days of real work per key and pay a rising bond for each one.
